docs.title: SoroStream Documentation 🌊
docs.text: Trustless, per-second linear asset streaming & cliff vesting protocol for Soroban Asset Contracts (SAC) on the Stellar Network.

docs.title: What is SoroStream?
docs.text: SoroStream is a native, trustless asset-streaming protocol and decentralized application built on Stellar using Soroban smart contracts (#![no_std]). It empowers DAOs, Web3 founders, grant allocators, and corporate payroll teams to lock Soroban Asset Contract (SAC) tokens—including XLM, USDC, and arbitrary SEP-41 compliant assets—and release them continuously to recipients second-by-second over customizable linear schedules.

docs.title: Key Value Propositions
docs.text:
• Per-Second Continuous Unlocking: Mathematical interpolation unlocks tokens smoothly as Stellar ledgers advance, without gas-expensive per-second storage updates.
  • Cliff Vesting Protection: Guarantee lockups with customizable cliff deadlines. Prior to cliff time, 0 tokens can be withdrawn.
  • Revocability & Fair Escrow Refunds: Senders can configure revocable streams. Upon revocation, earned tokens are instantly paid to the recipient, while unvested tokens are refunded to the sender.
  • Multi-Token SAC Compatibility: Supports native assets and any SEP-41 token with decimal normalization and balance tracking.
  • Batch CSV Distributions: Onboard entire contributor rosters or payroll cohorts in a single atomic transaction.
  • BUX-Inspired Glassmorphic UI: High-contrast slate canvas (#090D16), glowing emerald accents (#10B981), Bento grid metric cards, and live per-second tickers.

docs.title: FastAPI Indexer & RPC Engine API Reference
docs.text:
The SoroStream backend provides an OpenAPI-compliant REST engine for caching on-chain stream states, computing mathematical linear vesting states, verifying SEP-41 SAC tokens, and dispatching webhook notifications.

Interactive Swagger documentation is available at /docs and ReDoc at /redoc.

docs.title: Protocol Architecture & Specifications
docs.text: SoroStream is designed for minimal gas consumption, absolute deterministic accounting, and high-performance client synchronization on the Stellar network.

docs.title: Architecture Sequence Diagram
docs.text:
The following sequence diagram outlines the complete lifecycle of a streaming escrow from stream creation to per-second withdrawal and optional sender revocation:

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Sender as Sender / DAO Treasury
    participant Contract as SoroStream Contract (Soroban)
    participant Vault as Token Vault (SEP-41 SAC)
    participant RPC as Soroban RPC
    participant Indexer as FastAPI Indexer Backend
    actor Recipient as Recipient / Beneficiary

    Sender->>Contract: create_stream(recipient, token, amount, start, cliff, end, revocable)
    Contract->>Vault: transfer(sender, contract, amount)
    Contract->>RPC: emit Event: ("created", sender, recipient)
    RPC-->>Indexer: Ingest event & cache in SQLite DB

    Note over Recipient,Contract: Linear Vesting Accumulates Second-by-Second

    Recipient->>Contract: withdraw(stream_id)
    Contract->>Contract: compute_unlocked_amount(timestamp)
    Contract->>Vault: transfer(contract, recipient, claimable)
    Contract->>RPC: emit Event: ("withdraw", recipient)
    RPC-->>Indexer: Update claimed_amount in DB & dispatch Webhook

    alt Sender Revocation (if revocable)
        Sender->>Contract: cancel_stream(sender, stream_id)
        Contract->>Vault: transfer(contract, recipient, claimable)
        Contract->>Vault: transfer(contract, sender, refund_unvested)
        Contract->>RPC: emit Event: ("cancel", sender)
        RPC-->>Indexer: Mark is_cancelled=true (StreamCancelled)
    end

docs.title: Mathematical Specification
docs.text:
Rather than updating balances on every ledger second, SoroStream computes available tokens dynamically upon invocation using on-chain ledger timestamps:

Let: - \(t\): Current ledger timestamp (env.ledger().timestamp()) - \(t_{\text{start}}\): Stream start timestamp - \(t_{\text{cliff}}\): Cliff threshold timestamp - \(t_{\text{end}}\): Stream completion timestamp - \(A_{\text{total}}\): Total tokens committed to the stream - \(A_{\text{claimed}}\): Cumulative tokens already withdrawn

docs.title: Dynamic Unlock Formula
docs.text: \[\text{Unlocked}(t) = \begin{cases}  0 & \text{if } t < t_{\text{cliff}} \\ A_{\text{total}} & \text{if } t \ge t_{\text{end}} \\ \left\lfloor \frac{A_{\text{total}} \times (t - t_{\text{start}})}{t_{\text{end}} - t_{\text{start}}} \right\rfloor & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}\]

docs.title: Claimable Delta
docs.text: \[\text{Claimable}(t) = \max(0, \text{Unlocked}(t) - A_{\text{claimed}})\]

docs.title: Security Invariants & Attack Mitigations
docs.text: Attack Vector Vulnerability Precondition Protocol Mitigation Cliff Bypass Beneficiary calls withdraw() before \(t < t_{\text{cliff}}\) Smart contract enforces \(t < t_{\text{cliff}} \implies \text{Unlocked} = 0\); rejects with Error::NothingToWithdraw Double-Withdrawal Race Repeated rapid invocations to drain unearned funds Mutable state update precedes token transfer; subsequent calls find \(\text{Claimable} = 0\) Unauthorized Revocation Third-party attacker calls cancel_stream() Contract verifies sender.require_auth() and checks record.sender == sender Immutable Stream Cancellation Sender attempts to revoke non-revocable escrow Contract rejects with Error::StreamNotRevocable if record.revocable == false Double-Cancellation Attack Repeated cancel calls to duplicate refund payouts Contract flags record.is_cancelled = true on initial call; rejects secondary calls with Error::StreamAlreadyCancelled Integer Underflow / Time Warp Corrupted timestamps with \(t_{\text{start}} > t_{\text{cliff}}\) Enforced invariant: \(t_{\text{start}} \le t_{\text{cliff}} < t_{\text{end}}\) and \(A_{\text{total}} > 0\)

docs.title: Smart Contract: vesting_stream
docs.text: The core on-chain escrow protocol is implemented in #![no_std] Rust using soroban-sdk v21.0.0. It is located in contracts/vesting_stream/.

docs.title: State Keys & Data Structures
docs.text:
The contract utilizes Soroban persistent storage to maintain stream records and auto-incrementing stream counters:

#[derive(Clone)]
#[contracttype]
pub enum DataKey {
    Admin,         // Address of contract admin
    StreamCounter, // Auto-incrementing u64 identifier
    Stream(u64),   // Persistent key mapped to StreamRecord
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
#[contracttype]
pub struct StreamRecord {
    pub id: u64,              // Unique stream ID
    pub sender: Address,      // Stream funder
    pub recipient: Address,   // Beneficiary entitled to withdrawals
    pub token: Address,       // SAC token address (SEP-41)
    pub total_amount: i128,   // Total stroops deposited
    pub claimed_amount: i128, // Accumulated stroops withdrawn
    pub start_time: u64,      // Commencement timestamp (sec)
    pub cliff_time: u64,      // Cliff deadline (sec)
    pub end_time: u64,        // Vesting end timestamp (sec)
    pub revocable: bool,      // Whether sender can cancel stream
    pub is_cancelled: bool,   // Revocation state flag
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
#[contracttype]
pub struct StreamInfo {
    pub record: StreamRecord,
    pub unlocked_amount: i128,
    pub claimable_amount: i128,
}

docs.title: initialize
docs.text:
pub fn initialize(env: Env, admin: Address) -> Result<(), Error>
Initializes the contract administrator and resets StreamCounter to 0. Can only be invoked once.

docs.title: create_stream
docs.text:
pub fn create_stream(
    env: Env,
    sender: Address,
    recipient: Address,
    token: Address,
    amount: i128,
    start: u64,
    cliff: u64,
    end: u64,
    revocable: bool,
) -> Result<u64, Error>
Locks amount tokens from sender into contract escrow via TokenClient::transfer. Validates \(t_{\text{start}} \le t_{\text{cliff}} < t_{\text{end}}\) and amount > 0. Returns the newly generated unique stream_id.

docs.title: create_stream_batch
docs.text:
pub fn create_stream_batch(
    env: Env,
    sender: Address,
    streams: Vec<CreateStreamArgs>,
) -> Result<Vec<u64>, Error>
Atomic batch creation supporting corporate payroll and DAO contributor cohorts in a single transaction.

docs.title: withdraw
docs.text:
pub fn withdraw(env: Env, stream_id: u64) -> Result<i128, Error>
Calculates claimable unlocked tokens as of env.ledger().timestamp() and transfers the claimable balance to recipient.

docs.title: cancel_stream
docs.text:
pub fn cancel_stream(env: Env, sender: Address, stream_id: u64) -> Result<(), Error>
Requires sender.require_auth(). Validates that the stream is revocable and not previously cancelled. Payouts earned tokens to recipient, refunds unvested balance to sender, marks is_cancelled = true, and emits event cancel.

docs.title: get_stream
docs.text:
pub fn get_stream(env: Env, stream_id: u64) -> Result<StreamInfo, Error>
Read-only query returning the stream record along with real-time unlocked_amount and claimable_amount.

docs.title: Unit Testing & Verification
docs.text:
The contract includes a comprehensive test suite in contracts/vesting_stream/src/test.rs covering 16 distinct test scenarios: - test_initialization: Proper setup and duplicate rejection - test_create_stream_validation: Time bound rules and positive amount enforcement - test_zero_and_negative_amount_creation: Rejection of zero or negative token values - test_cliff_boundary_exact_enforcement: Strict zero claimable prior to cliff, exact unlock at cliff - test_create_and_linear_vesting: Linear rate accuracy across ledger ticks - test_cancel_revocable_stream: Sender refund and recipient claimable split - test_unauthorized_cancellation_attempt: Non-sender cancellation rejection - test_double_cancellation_fails: Duplicate cancellation rejection - test_non_revocable_stream_cannot_be_cancelled: Rejection on immutable escrows - test_batch_stream_creation: Multi-recipient atomic creation - test_getter_functions_and_invalid_id: Query error handling and count validation

Run the test suite with: 

cargo test

docs.title: TypeScript Client SDK: @sorostream/sdk
docs.text: The @sorostream/sdk library provides typed abstractions for interacting with SoroStream smart contracts, executing client-side vesting calculations, polling RPC states, and signing transactions via Freighter wallet.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: npm install @sorostream/sdk

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
import { SoroStreamClient, calculateVesting } from "@sorostream/sdk";

// Initialize SDK client
const client = new SoroStreamClient({
  indexerUrl: "https://soro-stream.vercel.app", // or http://localhost:8000
  rpcUrl: "https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org",
  contractId: "CA4L7T6R74G3T5F5V7V7RWWUHE2J76Y4WJ3L7C2WJ3L7C2WJ3L7C2WJ3",
});

// Fetch stream and live calculation
const stream = await client.getStream(1);
console.log(`Stream #${stream.id} Status: ${stream.status}`);
console.log(`Claimable: ${stream.claimableTokensFormatted} ${stream.tokenSymbol}`);

docs.title: getStream(streamId: number): Promise<StreamDetail>
docs.text: Fetches on-chain stream data and applies synchronous linear unlock calculation.

docs.title: listStreams(params?: { sender?: string; recipient?: string; status?: string }): Promise<StreamDetail[]>
docs.text: Queries all streams filtered by creator, beneficiary, or status.

docs.title: createStream(params: CreateStreamParams): Promise<StreamDetail>
docs.text: Validates parameters (\(t_{\text{start}} \le t_{\text{cliff}} < t_{\text{end}}\) and amount > 0) and submits creation.

docs.title: withdraw(streamId: number, actor?: string): Promise<StreamDetail>
docs.text: Claims all currently unlocked tokens for the beneficiary.

docs.title: cancelStream(streamId: number, sender: string): Promise<StreamDetail>
docs.text: Revokes a revocable stream, paying claimable tokens to recipient and refunding unvested escrow to sender.

docs.title: pollClaimableBalance(streamId: number, callback: (claimable: bigint, formatted: string) => void, intervalMs?: number): () => void
docs.text: Sets up a high-frequency polling subscription executing callback every second for real-time live ticker components. Returns an unsubscribe function.

docs.title: pollBalance(accountAddress: string, callback: (balance: BalanceResult) => void, intervalMs?: number): () => void
docs.text: Monitors an account's token balance on-chain and triggers updates upon balance changes.

docs.title: signTransactionWithFreighter(xdr: string, signer?: FreighterSigner): Promise<string>
docs.text: Passes an XDR transaction envelope to Freighter extension for cryptographic signing.

docs.title: Pure Mathematical Vesting Helpers
docs.text:
import { calculateVesting } from "@sorostream/sdk";

const result = calculateVesting({
  totalAmount: BigInt(100_000_0000000), // 100 tokens
  claimedAmount: BigInt(0),
  startTime: 1700000000,
  cliffTime: 1700050000,
  endTime: 1700200000,
  isCancelled: false,
  currentTime: 1700100000,
});

console.log(`Unlocked: ${result.unlockedAmount}`);
console.log(`Claimable: ${result.claimableAmount}`);
console.log(`Percent Vested: ${result.percentVested}%`);
